label: Doctor's tip · B12
head: Where does
B12 come from?
name: Dr. Michael Klaper
end_cta: Find Dr. Michael Klaper on Vegans Explore

captions.text: Vitamin B12, cobalamin, is absolutely essential
to keep your brain healthy, to keep your blood healthy,
keep your spinal cord healthy. We need some.
Couple times a week, you need some vitamin B12.
Animals don't make it. Cows don't make it.
Chickens don't make it. Pigs don't make it.
No animal makes it. Humans don't make it either.
It's made by microbes that live in the soil
and in the natural world, in the streams and the rivers.
That's where vitamin B12 comes from.
So when people eat beef, red meat, to get B12,
but the cow didn't make it.
That was bacterial B12 all along.
